name: CloneArmyMC: Star Wars RP!
description:
Clone Army MC is a Star Wars Minecraft Bedrock Edition server where players can join the Clone Army and become a clone trooper.

Our server offers many clone trooper divisions for players to join such as the 501st, 212th, and many more. Players can get promoted in the Clone Army by attending events.

The server offers many fun events like battles, trainings, and more.

We are always looking for new players to join in on our events! 

This is a Minecraft Bedrock Edition only server.
